activity_summary: You counted twenty-six pound and eight shillings. Six went into the belt, and twenty pound and eight stayed under two locks. The pack-list ended shorter than either first list. Mistress Ansell asked the plot of walking a hundred miles, and you said a man goes home. Verbeke tied the knot. Alse asked about players, and you said not this month.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted, chose the short list, and answered her.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Gave a light list, took offence at heavy, and allowed the plot if he arrives.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Said the list back by ear, and asked about players.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Tied the knot and spoke over it.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Sat on the cloth over Holinshed.

entities.name: the Verona sheets
entities.context: Mentioned in Half of it is heavy

facets.activity: Counted the money and closed the pack

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A hundred miles on your feet, and you with a share in a playhouse! What is the plot of that?

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Then see he arrives, and I'll allow it

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: Are there players in Warwickshire, sir?
